author: olgasi
quote: Never trust a sales person... We all condition ourselves through past experiences. There have been instances when we were sold products that turned out to be nothing like what we expected. That's why, when we happen to encounter a sales agent who takes the time to understand our true needs and makes the sale based solely on that, we feel like we are being served rather than sold. We maintain contact and recommend such individuals to our circle. I teach how to turn your clients into your ambassadors, it's easier then you think.
title: Never trust a sales person...
